title: Quantum-Markov blanket boundary transfer
question: Does a finite Gibbs state admit a measurable quantum-Markov blanket around a local core, so that boundary transfer can be parameterized by conditional mutual information and a recoverability scale before applying the local spectral window?

model.tripartition: A=local core, B=contiguous buffer collar, C=remaining environment; omitted exterior sites are traced out
model.recoverability_scale: sqrt(2 I(A:C|B)) as a finite natural-log diagnostic; no recovery map or infinite-volume bound is asserted
model.petz_diagnostic: trace distance between rho_ABC and the finite Petz reconstruction from rho_AB, rho_BC and rho_B
model.spectral_complement: Q_{A,E} rho_A Q_{A,E} for the isolated local core Hamiltonian
model.analytic_target: prove a boundary-conditioned Gibbs complement estimate by a buffer-width tail modulus, then transfer the cutoff-independent invariant form core

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks scalar QCMI decomposition, square-root recoverability scale and finite trace-distance range; entropy spectra, Petz maps, partial traces and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: On the finite declared grid, QCMI and a finite Petz reconstruction provide an auditable core-buffer-environment boundary diagnostic before spectral projection.
qft_interface.open: A buffer-width tail modulus, Gibbs complement theorem, cutoff/source/volume/shape uniformity, beta/eta independence, common core, Cook/common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary finite quantum-information interface only; no physical-sector conclusion or production-owner transfer is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite quantum-Markov blanket and spectral-complement stress only. It proves no buffer-width Gibbs tail, cutoff- or volume-uniform bound, common core, beta/eta-independent topology, domain or Cook/common-alpha convergence, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A result.
no_overclaim: Small conditional mutual information would identify a candidate boundary-transfer scale, not a uniform Gibbs complement theorem; large cutoff or buffer stress remains an explicit obstruction rather than being averaged away.
